## Feature Development Checklist

> Skip items that genuinely do not apply and explain why in a comment.

- [ ] `make test` passes locally
- [ ] `make lint` passes locally
- [ ] New or updated **unit / integration tests** added (`_test.go` co-located with the package)
- [ ] **E2E tests** added or updated in `e2e/tests/` and `make e2e-test` passes
- [ ] **`docs/api.md`** updated for any new or changed endpoints (method, path, body, response, permissions)
- [ ] **`docs/architecture.md`** updated if system design or data flow changed (diagrams in Mermaid)
- [ ] **`docs/end-user-guide.md`** updated with screenshots for any UI-visible change
- [ ] **`docs/settings.md`** updated if a new config key or setting was added
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, or secrets appear in logs, errors, or debug output
- [ ] `password_hash` fields tagged `json:"-"` wherever applicable
